C08-M12-L02-F1.title: Reconcile the second intake batch
C08-M12-L02-F1.caption: Later records can link, add evidence, confirm a response or raise a separate review task.
C08-M12-L02-F1.alt: Five categories show exact duplicates linked to original evidence, new observations added to a case, requests logged as pending, verified effects recorded, and unresolved records routed to an owner.
C08-M12-L02-F1.note: A source timestamp and its arrival order can differ.
